summary.name: Automata
summary.one_liner: Automata is an experimental, self-programming AI system that uses LLMs such as GPT-4 and a vector database to document, search, and write code.
use_cases: generate code embeddings for a codebase
run an autonomous agent on coding tasks
build SCIP indices for code search
summary.what_it_does: Automata describes itself as an evolving, autonomous, self-programming AI system built on large language models such as GPT-4 and a vector database. The docs cover how to generate code embeddings for the Automata Interpreter codebase, and how code and documentation generation supports its self-programming ability. It includes guides on creating SCIP indices for its search and on executing coding tasks with downstream tooling. It also documents running an Automata agent, including trivial and non-trivial instructions. The page is mostly a documentation index, with module reference pages auto-generated by a run-doc-embedding pipeline that the page says is still a work in progress.
